tailoring.headline: Ecommerce platforms/marketplaces implementations Consultant
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional e-commerce consultant with 5+ years of experience delivering large-scale enterprise platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Proven expertise bridging business strategy and IT: requirements engineering, process mapping, solution design, and data/API integrations. Skilled in managing end-to-end implementation projects, collaborating with international stakeholders, and utilizing AI-assisted delivery. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Ecommerce platforms/marketplaces implementations Consultant (Song GN)
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Ecommerce Platforms/Marketplaces Implementations Consultant role at Accenture Poland. Bringing over 5 years of hands-on experience delivering enterprise e-commerce platforms like SAP Commerce Cloud at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I combine deep technical platform knowledge with robust techno-functional consulting skills.

bullets.label: Requirements Engineering & Solution Design
bullets.text: Extensively analysed business requirements with product owners and business teams, authored user stories and functional specifications, and translated them into robust SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: End-to-End Implementation & Integrations
bullets.text: Managed end-to-end platform workflows including PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines, OCC REST API development, Promotions Engine configuration, and Order Management systems.

bullets.label: Stakeholder & International Collaboration
bullets.text: Collaborated seamlessly with international technical teams, system integrators, and business stakeholders to investigate integration bottlenecks and ensure smooth deployment.

bullets.label: Testing & UAT Support
bullets.text: Supported user acceptance testing (UAT), executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, and provided ongoing production troubleshooting and hypercare support.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am serving a notice period with a last working day of 15 December 2026 and am available to start on 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my expertise aligns with Accenture's digital commerce transformation initiatives.

tailoring.why_company: I want to drive digital commerce transformation at Accenture Poland because of your leadership in shaping cutting-edge enterprise strategies for global brands. My 5+ years of hands-on platform implementation, requirements analysis, and international stakeholder management at Rockwell Automation and Shell position me to deliver high-impact results across complex e-commerce ecosystems.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce platform delivery, techno-functional analysis, and cross-functional stakeholder collaboration to Accenture's digital commerce initiatives.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I saw Accenture Poland's Ecommerce Consultant opening. With 5+ years building enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud) and bridging business and IT through requirements analysis and integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I would love to connect.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Ecommerce platforms/marketplaces implementations Consultant (Song GN) - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find my CV and cover letter attached for the Ecommerce platforms/marketplaces implementations Consultant position at Accenture Poland.

With over 5 years of experience in e-commerce platform implementation, requirements engineering, solution design, and stakeholder collaboration at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am well-prepared to contribute to your digital commerce transformation projects.

I am based in Germany with a valid work permit, serving notice until 15.12.2026, and available from 16.12.2026. I look forward to discussing my application.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
